Use this for README, examples, starter-vault instructions, and template wording improvements. Keep suggestions generic and public-safe.

## Page or file

Which Markdown file should change?

`README.md`, `examples/...`, `starter-vault/...`, etc.

## Current problem

What is unclear, missing, too long, or hard to adopt?

## Proposed improvement

Describe the wording, structure, example, or link you want to add.

## Who would this help most?

- [ ] First-time user
- [ ] OSS maintainer
